name.g: a name, kept as in the Hebrew

yy.g: Hashem — Onkelos writes יְיָ both for the Name and for אֱלֹהִים

yat.g: marks the direct object (= Hebrew אֶת)

gly.g: to uncover, reveal; to go into exile; (passive participle) revealed, known

hzy.g: to see; (Itpe'el) to be seen, appear

meimra.g: word; (of Hashem) His Word, the Memra

msr.g: to hand over; (passive participle) handed over, given

kns.g: to gather; (Itpa'al) to be gathered together

qbl2.g: to receive, accept; (לְמֵימַר) to listen to

sad.g: to sustain, refresh (סְעִידוּ לִבְּכוֹן = refresh yourselves)

lbsh.g: to wear, put on; (Af'el) to clothe

mattara.g: charge, guard (נְטַר מַטְּרַת = kept the charge)

shry.g: to dwell, rest; to begin; (Af'el) to settle, place

ngd.g: to draw, pull; (passive participle) drawn, beaten (metal work); (Itpe'el) to expire, pass away

ry.g: to want, be pleased; (Itpe'el) to choose, be desired

ganya.g: hidden; honored (lit. the one set apart)

dil.g: belonging to (with a suffix: his, hers …)

ad.g: until, up to; (עַד לָא) before, not yet

qadmeita.g: the beginning; (בְּקַדְמֵיתָא) at first, from the east

saad.g: support, help (בְּסַעֲדָךְ = with you, at your side)

trk.g: to drive out, banish; (passive participle) divorced woman

lhod.g: alone, only (with a suffix: by himself)

drk.g: to tread (מִדְרַךְ פַּרְסַת רִגְלָא = a footstep)

qwm2.g: to establish, fulfil; (Itpa'al) to endure, last

avr.g: to pass, cross; (Af'el) to cause to pass

shlm.g: to be finished, come to an end; (Pa'el) to pay, repay; (Af'el) to hand over, repay
